problem_type: Short identity enum chip compressed until its value is unreadable in a no-wrap footer
symptom: At the 1100x720 minimum window in English, the image-node composer footer showed 'Variant 5.0' as 'Variant E': the value span was squeezed to 5px (walkthrough measurement), so the digit was cut mid-glyph; zh fit.
direct_cause: In the canvas composer's summary layout InlineParameterBar left both identity chips (model and variant) shrinkable. The variant chip's leading label is shrink-0, so all the lost width came out of its short value span; the English row is wider ('Variant', '1 outputs') and ran out of width first.
class_root: The rule 'short enum chips never shrink; only the model chip yields, with an intentional ellipsis and full-name title' existed for the storyboard composer bar (composerBarGeometry.ts) but not for the canvas composer's summary layout, which still let every identity chip shrink.
affected_population: Canvas generation composers whose model has variants (image and video), narrow cards (minimum window, narrow stage), longer locales such as en
entry_points: Canvas node composer footer (NodeParameterControls -> InlineParameterBar summary layout)
Paid confirmation card footer (InlineParameterBar chips layout)
internal_only_reason: Product layout rule from docs/design/2026-09-10-node-composer-bar-v1.md (never wrap, no fourth segment) and the storyboard bar precedent; no third-party behavior decides which chip yields
invariants: In a no-wrap composer footer only the model chip yields width; it truncates with an ellipsis and exposes the full name in title; short enum chips (variant) never shrink

door_reduction.why_not: Generated by node scripts/door-map.mjs variantChipClass modelChipClass composerModelChipMinWidth. The storyboard composer bar (ShotComposerBar via composerBarGeometry) and the canvas composer (InlineParameterBar) are separate surfaces with different rows; both now apply the same rule, and InlineParameterBar owns both of its layouts in one place.

generality_proof: The shrink policy is decided once per chip role inside InlineParameterBar for every model and locale; no locale or model name is special-cased, and the walkthrough measures every footer chip's text box rather than a specific label.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Short identity enum never shrinks; model chip is the only compressible identity chip in summary layout

same_class_entry_points.evidence: InlineParameterBar.test.ts asserts variant shrink-0 and model compressible; walkthrough 1100x720 en: 0 clipped chip texts
Already applies the rule (short enums shrink-0, model has a floor) via composerBarGeometry.ts

recurrence.reason: Any narrower card, longer locale, or new variant label reproduces it on the canvas composer unless the role rule is fixed at the chip owner.
same_class_scan: rg leadingLabel src/workbench -> InlineParameterBar variant chip
rg data-node-composer-footer src -> NodeGenerationComposer footer is the only canvas composer footer

prevention.invariant: Short enum identity chips never shrink in a no-wrap footer
prevention.failure_mode: If the row still cannot fit, the model chip truncates with an ellipsis and keeps its full name in title
prevention.strategy: Split the single identityChipClass into model and variant roles so shrink priority follows the storyboard bar rule

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the shared identityChipClass that let the variant chip shrink in summary layout

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pure layout policy in our own component

residual_risks: The design doc line 'summary: identity chips may compress (2026-07-17)' is narrowed to the model chip; recorded in the report for the user. Extremely long model names at the minimum window still reduce the model chip to an ellipsis (title keeps the full name); the walkthrough requires at least 24px of visible text

invariant_owner_layer.why: The chip roles for both footer layouts are decided in this component
